title: SCIF meeting with AARO head Jon Kosloski

tellings.quote: And he's like, "You know, James, I can't part my hair without the approval of the DoD."

plain: The documentary filmmaker James Fox says he met Jon Kosloski, head of a Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained sightings, in a secure room for classified talks near the Pentagon, sometime in the 2020s. Fox, who made the film The Phenomenon, tells it as his own meeting and says Kosloski told him, "You know, James, I can't part my hair without the approval of the DoD," meaning the Department of Defense, which Fox offers as a sign of how little the office head could say on his own.
